svg.title: Goiter at the seats of 239 Bavarian districts, 1858 to 1861
svg.desc: Each point is a district seat, colored by how the district physician described goiter (Kropf). Red points: goiter endemic or frequent. Amber points: goiter rare, limited to some places, or reported without being called frequent. The blue point, Nittenau: the physician found no one with goiter. Hollow points: no goiter statement was captured in the image-verified pages, which does not mean that goiter was absent. Cretinism has a separate column in the dataset and is not shown. Upper Bavaria is blank because its reports are not in this collection.
